parameters.command: =PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD psql -h {{$json.host}} -p {{$json.port}} -U {{$json.user}} -d {{$json.database}} -t -A -c "SELECT json_build_object('connections', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity), 'max_connections', (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name='max_connections'), 'db_sizes', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', datname, 'size_mb', round(pg_database_size(datname)/1024.0/1024.0, 1))) FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate = false), 'replication_lag', (SELECT CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()) * 1000 ELSE 0 END), 'idle_in_transaction', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND now() - state_change > interval '5 minutes'), 'version', (SELECT version()))"
